about: A made-up song in a look and a format at a moment, and every row of text and every shape the video draws then, read back from the subtitle file (u: 1% of the frame's short side; x is the edge the alignment names, top the row's top edge). lines.text: Tell me where the night bus goes
We could ride it till the morning finds us sleeping at the end of the line
Hold on (hold on) till the light
